turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We've played the same three games every week for a year. I'm bored.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Time for something new. Do you want a short game you can play a few rounds of, or one long epic game for the whole evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, can you wait? My friend is talking to me. Keep quiet until I come back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Rosa, do we still have garlic or did you use the last of it?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I think there's half a bulb in the cupboard by the kettle.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Half a bulb won't be enough. Could you grab some on your way back from work?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure, anything else while I'm there?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Maybe a lemon. And check if they have fresh parsley.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. So, quick rounds or one big game?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Short ones. People tend to show up late.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good point. Quick card games let late arrivals jump in at the next round.
